name: MobileSAM
plain: MobileSAM: Segment Anything with a small TinyViT image encoder distilled from the largest SAM.
summary: MobileSAM (Zhang et al. 2023, Kyung Hee University): Segment Anything with the ViT-H image encoder replaced by a TinyViT-5M (an MBConv stage, then window attention with depthwise convs) distilled from it; SAM's own prompt encoder and mask decoder, so points, boxes and mask logits work the same. The portable `module()` is the image encoder only.

papers.title: Faster Segment Anything: Towards Lightweight SAM for Mobile Applications

task_io: Input: one image plus a point, box or text prompt. Output: masks with quality scores.

variants.name: mobile-sam

licence.evidence: https://github.com/ChaoningZhang/MobileSAM/blob/f706ad9c4eb7f219c00d9050e46328518ffb65d2/LICENSE (Apache-2.0; weights/mobile_sam.pt is in the same tree and the README names no other terms); the same file from a co-author: https://huggingface.co/dhkim2810/MobileSAM/blob/4e2e5245fe9dc63096d575d36e70eb39b03b3aba/README.md (license: mit); TinyViT: https://github.com/microsoft/Cream/blob/4a13c4091e78f9abd2160e7e01c02e48c1cf8fb9/LICENSE
licence.training_note: image encoder distilled from SAM ViT-H on 1 % of SA-1B (about 100k images) per the README and paper; prompt encoder and mask decoder are SAM's (trained on SA-1B: 11M licensed images, 1.1B automatically generated masks); the dataset itself is under the SA-1B research licence

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized inside to the fixed encoder input 1024x1024 (the default export size)

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original32.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True)

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: COCO val2017, every 10th image, point prompts, mIoU best of 3 / single mask %
quality.protocol: One point per ground-truth instance (the interior point farthest from the border); IoU of the best-scored of 3 masks / of the single mask.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0013 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.81 % and p99 <= 4.1 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `pred_masks`).
